images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: two engineers mid-handoff in a dim operations room — one calmly passes the other a small, precisely organized glowing dossier of documents and diagrams; behind the first engineer, a fire smolders contained inside a glass server cabinet, casting warm light. Composure over panic; the handoff is the hero. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights, thin red (#eb2027) accent as a single seal mark on the dossier only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. No readable text, letters, or numbers anywhere. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition.
